members.author: Zelys-DFKH

members.title: fix: make ClientSessionGroup streamable HTTP errors catchable
members.author: VrtxOmega
members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both PRs address the same root cause: `ClientSessionGroup.__aenter__` and `__aexit__` were marked `# pragma: no cover`, making it impossible to write tests that cover error propagation through those methods. Both start from the same base commit (`9610212642`) and both modify `__aexit__`. PR #2711 removes only the coverage pragmas; PR #2637 removes the same pragmas implicitly (by adding real tests that cover those paths) AND fixes the underlying concurrency bug that prevented errors from surfacing — replacing the `anyio.create_task_group` concurrent close with a sequential loop to preserve AnyIO task contexts. (2 PRs)
